judgments.reason: The wholeb759 and actual profile teach hydrogen/oxygen electrode and overall chemistry, external electron work, internal ion conduction and the distinction between hydrogen as energy carrier and the cell as converter. These are the chemical principles needed to explain the fuel-cell side of the actual comparative tasks. The fresh layout/blockage/supply case probes the principle rather than reliance on copied half-equations. Together with retained energy-boundary foundation4928, this makes the comparative energy and supplied upstream/efficiency calculations scientifically accessible.

judgments.reason: The actualecce profile additionally demands acid-versus-alkaline electrode chemistry, OH- versusH+ transport and water-formation location, carbonate/air-supply hypotheses and controlled followups. Neither actual0cf2 complete case requires comparison of those electrolyte chemistries, derivation of alkaline half-equations or carbonate management. Their full mastery is therefore not a universal acquisition condition for comparing the supplied fuel-cell/power-plant paths. This conclusion comes from the actual demands, not from a missing BY role or an assumption that all earlier-phase content must suffice.

One-kWh output normalization and two conversion efficiencies yield2kWh H2,20/7kWh upstream electricity and8/7kg CO2e versus91/220kg for the given gas chain. Reducing upstream electricity intensity to0.03 yields3/35kg, changing this bounded carbon result without supplying costs or resolving social risks. The CHP case correctly separates available heat from used heat, keeps winter70%/50% and summer50%/30%, and does not compare unequal services as if equal. No entropy/Carnot, acid/alkaline pair, or real-device measurement duty is hidden in these tasks.

Boundary, energy transfer and energy accounting remain relevant. Its explicit closed-system, balanced-pressure, PV-only conditions delimit its heat equalities. Those special equalities must not be applied directly to an open fuel-cell flow with electrical work. The supplied0cf2 comparisons instead use stated conversion efficiencies and service/upstream balances; no thermo formula extension or altered4928 duty is proposed.

Replacing one prerequisite does not remove, retag or weaken the wholeecce source, profile, applicable course obligations or placements.0cf2 source/description/tasks/solutions/images remain the same. No new ordinary target, evidence quota, broad source-union approval or learner mastery is inferred. Actual existing b759 roles must still be verified in all25 comparison contexts.
